Main.title: Full control of your Fleet in real time
Main.description: Monitor vehicles, optimize routes and reduce costs with our comprehensive GPS fleet management platform. Get complete visibility into your fleet operations.

items.0: Location of all vehicles on the map
items.2: Alerts when a route is deviated from

Advantages.title: We solve each of these problems
Advantages.subtitle: Every issue is covered by a specific tool

fuel.painDescription: Costs keep rising — nobody controls consumption and routes
fuel.solutionDescription: Online consumption monitoring, spotting unnecessary trips, route optimisation

transport.painDescription: Unclear where vehicles are, whether routes are followed, or if there are deviations
transport.solutionDescription: All vehicles on the map in real time, route control and notifications

drivers.painDescription: No visibility into work: speed, discipline, violations — everything is blind
drivers.solutionDescription: Full action history, speed control, improved discipline

analytics.painDescription: Manual reports, stale data — decisions are made without real data
analytics.solutionDescription: Automatic reports, mileage and efficiency analytics for every vehicle

Solution.title: All solutions on one platform
Solution.subtitle: We are proud that our platform is easy to use and helps you solve tasks faster. Setup and launch in 3 simple steps.

install.title: Install GPS trackers
install.description: We provide compact GPS devices that are easily installed in any vehicle in your fleet.

connect.title: Connect to the platform
connect.description: Vehicles connect to the platform automatically. See them appear on your dashboard instantly.

monitor.title: Monitor and mobile
monitor.description: Track, analyze, and optimize your entire fleet from one powerful online platform.

BePartner.title: Become a partner
BePartner.intro: Companies lose millions to inefficient fleet management, extra mileage, downtime, and hidden costs. With your help, we can:

bullets.routes: Optimize routes and reduce fuel use
bullets.control: Monitor drivers and the fleet in real time

BePartner.outro: Join us — together we will make transport cheaper and more transparent for business.

Footer.tagline: Complete GPS fleet management solution for modern businesses
